mapper.select: select b.user_id , b.enterprise_profile_idnull as profile_id , v.published_timenull as verified_at , v.enterprise_namenull as name , v.unified_credit_codenull as credit_code , v.enterprise_typenull as type , v.legal_representative_namenull as legal_representative_name , v.legal_document_type_codenull as legal_document_type , case when char_length(v.legal_document_number) > 4 then concat(repeat('*', char_length(v.legal_document_number) - 4), right(v.legal_document_number, 4)) else repeat('*', char_length(v.legal_document_number)) endnull as legal_document_number_masked , v.legal_document_numbernull as legal_document_number , v.established_datenull as established_date , v.business_term_fromnull as business_term_from , v.business_term_untilnull as business_term_until , v.registered_addressnull as registered_address , v.business_scopenull as business_scope , v.contact_namenull as contact_name , v.contact_phonenull as contact_phone , v.emailnull as email , v.registered_capitalnull as registered_capital , v.industry_codenull as industry_code , v.websitenull as website from profile_enterprise_binding b join profile_enterprise p on p.enterprise_profile_id = b.enterprise_profile_id join profile_enterprise_version v on v.enterprise_version_id = p.current_version_id where b.user_id = #{userId} and b.status = 'ACTIVE' and b.del_flag = '0' and p.status = 'ACTIVE' and p.del_flag = '0' and v.status = 'CURRENT' and v.del_flag = '0'
